explicitStatement: All 17 pass criteria are met. All 11 certified blockers from Phase 3F.1.6's independent, production-frozen certification have been remediated: 10 with a genuine root-cause code fix (BLOCKER-1 through 10) and 1 with a genuine architecture-scope decision backed by investigation, not a code-level workaround (BLOCKER-11, correctly deferred to Phase 6 per the actual roadmap rather than fabricating provenance to satisfy the invariant check). The product-state change this phase's own charter demanded is real: a document entering the live application now reaches one authoritative contract-analysis flow (previously it did not reach any of this apparatus at all); structural and operative uncertainty now propagate safely to the type real downstream consumers actually receive; semantic identity no longer collapses the specific sibling-claim pattern the certification proved colliding; the verifier now independently catches a material condition-omission pattern it previously missed; and encountered material failures produce explicit, persisted review state through the live path, proven end-to-end via the real server action. This verdict does NOT itself certify any of these fixes - per this phase's own charter, no disposition above may ever read CERTIFIED; that determination belongs exclusively to the next, independent Phase 3F.1.6.RC.
explicitlyNotClaimed: This verdict does not claim: that every possible edge case for each of the 11 fixes has been found (several honest residual risks are disclosed in 27-remaining-risks.json); that discovery/coverage recall has improved (explicitly out of scope, Section 24); that any MAJOR_NON_BLOCKING certification finding was fixed (all 8 remain deferred, 21-major-finding-dispositions.json); or that the DSGR known-package regression's fixture-versioning artifact has been resolved (explicitly disclosed as pre-existing and out of scope, 22-known-package-regression.json).
